items.title: Klint Kubiak not ready to name the Raiders' starting quarterback
items.summary: Kirk Cousins looks like the Raiders' Week One starter, but Kubiak is holding off on announcing it.

items.title: Imran Khan returns to jail after being declared 'medically fit'
items.summary: Imran Khan has been incarcerated in Adiala Jail in Rawalpindi since August 2023, serving various prison sentences on corruption charges which he and his party deny.

items.title: I missed being valued as a footballer - Walti
items.summary: Brighton midfielder Lia Walti says she "missed the feeling of being valued as a footballer" at Juventus and craved a return to the WSL.
items.whyItMatters: Football creates regular global sports momentum and quick-return storylines.
